ratios.facility: Senior Credit Facility (Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement)
ratios.quote: Our Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio was 4.50, with the covenant requirement at 5.00 at the end of December 31, 2025.

parsed.notes: The Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio nets unrestricted cash against Consolidated Funded Indebtedness, so it is classed as net leverage. Under the June 2025 Amendment the maximum steps down: 5.00x through June 30, 2026; 4.75x at September 30, 2026; 4.50x at December 31, 2026; and 4.00x from March 31, 2027 onward. The full covenant table is in Note 5, which is not included in this excerpt. The Senior Credit Facility matures March 24, 2028, and the company expects to refinance in 2026. The same ratio also sets the interest rate margin and the commitment fee; those uses are excluded.
